description: This file defines the 'EmployeeAnniversaryAPI' class, which is an API endpoint for retrieving upcoming employee anniversaries in the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for handling GET requests to list anniversaries with filtering, sorting, and pagination. The class utilizes traits for anniversary services and date-time helpers, and references models, parameters, and service methods related to employee anniversaries.
